tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) to act severely, deal with severely, make a fool of someone
1a) (Poel) to act severely
1b) (Poal) to be severely dealt with
1c) (Hithpael) to busy oneself, divert oneself, deal wantonly, deal ruthlessly, abuse (by thrusting through)
1d) (Hithpoel) to practise practices, thrust forth (in wickedness)
(Poel) to act or play the child
(Poel) to insert, thrust, thrust in, thrust upon

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to effect thoroughly; specifically, to glean (also figuratively); by implication (in a bad sense) to overdo, i.e. maltreat, be saucy to, pain, impose (also literal)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: abuse, affect, [idiom] child, defile, do, glean, mock, practise, thoroughly, work (wonderfully).
